insight: Grew out of an open-source project for endangered languages.
name: Algebras AI
tagline: AI localization across text, audio, and video.
description: Algebras AI is an AI localization platform that translates UI strings, documents, audio, and video into 300+ languages and over 1,000 dialects with minimal proofreading. It offers real-time dubbing, adaptive subtitles, lip-synced video translation, glossaries, and QA checks, with integrations for Next.js, Unity, Unreal, GitHub Actions, and Zapier. An open-source CLI and API let teams wire localization into their build pipeline.
edge: Reaches rare and regional tongues — 300+ languages and 1,000+ dialects with dubbing and a CLI — where mainstream tools like DeepL stay thin.
